title: Expending agency.
bodyText: The department of land and natural resources shall expend all sums appropriated for the purposes of this chapter and in accordance with section 115-7.
bodyHtml: [§115-8]  Expending agency.  The department of land and natural resources shall expend all sums appropriated for the purposes of this chapter and in accordance with section 115-7. [L 1974, c 244, §8]
